reviews.title: Silver and Brown are the Best!
reviews.comment: I require a comfortable, pure sound wired headphone in my office to deliver listening therapies. These are not noise canceling, and I don’t want the noise canceling because it alters the pure sound. They are very comfortable and I clean them with a sanitizing wipe between clients, and they have held up for years! I use them with an iPhone dongle adapter, make sure you get a quality adapter. Those can be problematic. I’ve had no problems with the silver and brown ones with slightly oval earmuffs, and recommend these often.  I’ve ordered the black with round earmuffs before and one of the wires didn’t work on those and they weren’t as comfortable, so I stick with the brown.  And agreed, for the price these are really great! I use them for clients about 8 years and up.

reviews.title: Not recommended for phone with converter
reviews.comment:
Need: daily use on computer/phone, no DJ, just want a pair of wired headphones for a decent price. Need some noise cancelling (not expecting too much at this price level)
Review:
Pros: The headphone has decent sound quality. Very good bass, better than my qc35. The pads are comfortable for long time wearing, but might be a bit too hot in the summer.
Cons: there are several issues when I use it with my phone. I am using it with a 3.5mm to lightning converter on my phone.
First, I’ve heard sharp beeps several times when I connect this headphone with my phone. This has never happened with my other wired headphones.
Second, the connection via converter is very unstable. I have to plug and unplug several times to get the sound out from the headphone instead of my phone speaker.
Not sure if this is a converter or headphone issue, but as this never happens to my other wired headphones, I might consider returning it. If you don’t often use it on your phone, I still recommend these for good quality at this price.

reviews.title: Not expensive, but work well for over the ears headphones
reviews.comment: I enjoy listening to news and music via my laptop. My wife, of course, has her own interests, so we both wear headphones, unless we're enjoying something together. These are comfortable, a bargain, and contain the sound, rather than "leaking" audio. The only thing that was disappointing to me, is that they were so be shipped several days before I actually got tracking for them. Then they took another 10-12 days to arrive. I probably still would have ordered them, it just would have been nice to understand from the get-go, that the headphones would take a while to get to me. So, would I purchase them again? Yes, for sure.
reviews.author: Mighty Mouse

reviews.title: These were the only headphones that sounded good with hearing aids
reviews.comment:
My dad is hard of hearing and had to give up watching movies, his favorite pastime, because he can't understand the dialogue or hear the soundtrack. I've been looking for a solution for a few years now, mostly trying out various earbuds with dedicated headphone amps (and thus bypassing his hearing aids). Then a cheap, basic pair of over-ear HP headphones led to a breakthrough--in conjunction with his hearing aids, my dad was able to hear the audio at a level and clarity that brought him to tears. The only problem was that those headphones were USB and only compatible with his PC. So a new hunt began for a comparable set of analog over-ears he could use with the living room TV.
For whatever reason, of all the headphones I bought, the A71 was the only model that sounded as clear to him as those HPs. Even more expensive Audio Technicas didn't work. I don't know why (Models with similar ear cup dimensions to the HPs didn't work as well), but hey, I'll take the win. We're still in the process of testing, but it seems like these relatively cheap headphones might be what allows my dad to enjoy films again.
